create_ssim_loss: create SSIM loss computation for two image tensors with configurable data range and window size
compute_ms_ssim: compute multiscale SSIM between two image or video tensors for perceptual quality assessment
build_ssim_module: build a PyTorch nn.Module that returns negative SSIM as a differentiable loss function
build_ms_ssim_module: build a PyTorch nn.Module that returns negative multiscale SSIM as a differentiable loss
apply_gaussian_filter: apply 1-D Gaussian kernel filtering to 4-D image or 5-D video tensors
